title: Quantum algorithms for density functional theory with minimal readout
summary: While quantum computers have shown significant promise for electronic structure calculations, their potential to accelerate density functional theory (DFT) calculations remains unclear. In this work, we present a qubit-efficient encoding scheme for wavefunctions in Kohn--Sham (KS) DFT, together with a quantum algorithm that computes all occupied orbitals simultaneously.
